verdict.detail: The album's main issue on Discogs isn't vinyl; this is from the first year it was pressed on vinyl, one of 4 that year.

notes.text:
Limited edition 300 only black vinyl LP. Housed in either a a gloss finished or reverse board printed 350gsm board outer sleeve with black polylined inner with download code

The first 50 or so mail order copies also came with a folded A3 poster and A6 flyer
